mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calc_task (task_type, business_scope, request_key, status, priority, worker_id, lease_until, heartbeat_at, progress_current, progress_total, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_run_at, input_payload, input_checksum, result_resource_id, error_code, error_message, phase, success_roots, failed_roots, created_by) VALUES (#{taskType}, #{businessScope}, #{requestKey}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{workerId}, #{leaseUntil}, #{heartbeatAt}, #{progressCurrent}, #{progressTotal}, #{attemptCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRunAt}, #{inputPayload}, #{inputChecksum}, #{resultResourceId}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{phase}, #{successRoots}, #{failedRoots}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE calc_task SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE calc_task SET progress_current = #{progressCurrent}, progress_total = #{progressTotal}, phase = #{phase}, success_roots = #{successRoots}, failed_roots = #{failedRoots}, heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE calc_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = 'TIMEOUT', error_message = CONCAT('Task stuck in ', status, ' for more than ', #{timeoutMinutes}, ' minutes'), finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'CLAIMED', 'RUNNING') AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE)
